overview: Before dinner you finished the two notes and shut the comedy on one prose line. You kept the plain refusal. You did not copy the songs out a second time, and you did not give out a part.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Finished the notes, wrote the line, and kept the refusal.
